key_insight: SUMNO translates a multigrid V-cycle into a U-shaped neural operator, delivering strong fluid-flow predictions with 9.4 million parameters.
engineering_relevance: SUMNO offers a compact surrogate architecture for accelerating regular-grid CFD predictions across steady and unsteady flows.
method: Spatially unrolls a V-cycle using parameter-free down/up-sampling and additive coarse-grid corrections.
Keeps transfer and skip pathways normalization-free.
Combines fine/intermediate-grid convolutions with coarsest-grid shifted-window attention supporting per-axis periodicity.
evidence_signal: Across four benchmarks and five baselines on unseen test configurations, SUMNO ranks first in 5 of 7 settings and second in two, reducing 10-step rollout MSE by about 30% versus the strongest baseline.
watch_item: The architecture targets regular grids; applicability to irregular meshes and stability beyond the reported 10-step rollout require further evaluation.
paper_title: SUMNO: Spatially Unrolled Multigrid Neural Operator for Fluid Flow Surrogates
